messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: ArdentPay asked for a concise POC run plan and cost ballpark. Key asks: 99p <450ms at sustained 150 qps, ability to absorb 500 qps bursts up to 45s, and confirmation of HSM/CMEK for keys. Need a single page they can share with procurement.

devin_se: Proposed load profile: prewarm 2m @20 qps, 30m soak @150 qps, 5m linear ramp to burst, then 3 x 1m microbursts @500 qps with 5m cool-down between. Workload: interactive chat, avg prompt 120 tokens, response ~250 tokens. Running from east-us agents.

maria_sales: Sounds right. Add tracing and histogram export so we can show 99/99.9. Also note they want an indicative monthly Dedicated cost incl. occasional burst.

kai_perf: Technical config: model=rline-rdx-large-quant, KV-prefix cache ON (10m TTL), batch window=10ms, max batch tokens=64, sampling 100% traces for run. Expected perf: ~320 qps/GPU sustained for this trace-shaped load. For safety recommend 1 reserved + 1 burst node or 2 reserved if they want guaranteed bursts.

sam_eng: Ballpark cost (east-us): r4.x8g reserved node $9,200/mo. Add on-demand burst node amortized ~$1,100/mo if used sparsely. For strict guaranteed 500 qps bursts reserve second node (+$9,200). Ill make a small table for procurement.

ellie_security: HSM/CMEK is supported for Dedicated and Private. Key unwrap adds single-digit ms. We'll need a signed addendum and ops enabling CMEK in the cluster. I attached the addendum template in security-templates.

opsbot: [runbot] scheduled bench job id=bench-17456 starting on agent-east-3. Results path: /bench-results/ardentpay/1745609999.json

devin_se: Test harness (k6-style):

```
scenarios:
  prewarm:
    rate: 20
    duration: 2m
  soak:
    rate: 150
    duration: 30m
  ramp_to_burst:
    executor: ramping-arrival-rate
    startRate: 150
    stages:
      - target: 500
        duration: 5m
  microburst:
    rate: 500
    duration: 1m
    repeat: 3
headers:
  Authorization: "Bearer <POC_KEY>"
  X-Model: "rline-rdx-large-quant"
  X-Trace-Id: "autogen"
```

kai_perf: Note: cold-starts on quant model show ~80-120ms extra on first requests. Prewarm mitigates. Also include a rule to flag any 99p>450ms and ship traces.

opsbot: [runbot] prewarm complete: 2m @20qps, avg latency=78ms, cold-start median=105ms.

devin_se: Soak finished. Quick summary: 30m @150 qps, 99p=401ms, P95=198ms, error rate 0.02% (retries handled). Microbursts: all bursts reached target; transient ramp-up added ~220ms on first 10s when autoscaling; sustained burst period 45s would need reserved burst node to avoid ramp latency. Full results & CSV uploaded to /bench-results/ardentpay/1745609999.json and associated traces in /traces/1745609999/*.zip

maria_sales: Great — can you add a one-paragraph graceful degradation plan I can include? Also Sam, please attach the east-us and eu-west cost rows.

kai_perf: Fallback paragraph (brief): if capacity constrained route new requests to rdx-medium variant, reduce non-critical telemetry, and enable best-effort batching; for strict availability reserve burst nodes in same AZ or route traffic to a secondary region with warmed cache.

sam_eng: Cost rows posted to /pricing/ardentpay/1745609999-costs.csv (east-us, eu-west, and a reserved+burst option).

ellie_security: I'll prep the signed addendum template and list of required SOC/ISO artifacts. Expect legal review link by EOD.

maria_sales: Perfect. I'll send the one-pager to ArdentPay procurement including run highlights, fallback plan, and cost options. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
